chain.title: The First Exchange
chain.desc: Craft the Philosopher's Stone. It is used in ProjectE conversion recipes; keep it available as you begin the fuel and transmutation branches.

chain.title: Learn Before You Spend
chain.desc: Build a Transmutation Table. Teach it an item with an EMC value, supply EMC and retrieve an item you have learned. Items without EMC cannot simply be exchanged.

chain.title: Make an Exchange That Helps
chain.desc: Teach your table a useful material, supply enough EMC and withdraw that material. Confirm after completing the exchange. Pack authors can alter EMC values and exclude items.

chain.title: A Little Covalence
chain.desc: Make Low Covalence Dust for the alchemical storage branch. Keep the dust tiers separate; they are distinct ingredients, not interchangeable upgrades.

chain.title: The Middle Reagent
chain.desc: Make Medium Covalence Dust for recipes that need the full set of dusts. Check the installed recipe instead of assuming each tier upgrades from the previous one.

chain.title: The Final Reagent
chain.desc: Make High Covalence Dust. Combine the three dust branches when you are ready for the Alchemical Chest.

chain.title: Space for Your Alchemy
chain.desc: Craft an Alchemical Chest using the three covalence dusts and its other ingredients. This storage component leads toward bags and the Energy Condenser.

chain.title: Give Surplus a Purpose
chain.desc: Set an EMC-valued target in the Energy Condenser. Feed it suitable surplus and let it convert that value into the chosen output. Protect valuables from unintended input.

chain.title: Gather Ambient Energy
chain.desc: Build an Energy Collector and give it appropriate lighting. Watch its production before scaling up; this branch can support your growing EMC needs without a continuous supply of input items.

chain.title: Connect the Energy Array
chain.desc: Use an Antimatter Relay to route EMC in your collector setup. Arrange the machines together and check that the intended receiver is gaining energy.

chain.title: The First Fuel Conversion
chain.desc: Use the Philosopher's Stone conversion recipe to obtain Alchemical Coal. This is the first step toward the higher alchemical fuels.

chain.title: A Denser Fuel
chain.desc: Convert Alchemical Coal into Mobius Fuel. It branches toward both Klein Star storage and the final fuel tier.

chain.title: Carry a Reserve
chain.desc: Craft a Klein Star Ein and charge it through ProjectE's EMC systems. Its stored value can support compatible equipment; merely crafting a star does not fill it.

chain.title: Fuel for Greater Work
chain.desc: Convert Mobius Fuel into Aeternalis Fuel. Keep enough for the Dark Matter recipe before spending it elsewhere.

chain.title: Beyond Ordinary Materials
chain.desc: Combine the required fuel and diamond material to make Dark Matter. The new material opens equipment, machine upgrades and portable transmutation.

chain.title: A Material for Larger Projects
chain.desc: Craft Dark Matter Blocks when your next recipe calls for them. Check its actual quantity: a storage block recipe is not automatically a nine-item recipe.

chain.title: An Alchemical Smelter
chain.desc: Build the Dark Matter Furnace and arrange input, output and its fuel or EMC supply. Run a batch to learn the machine before routing your entire processing line through it.

chain.title: A Tool for the Long Run
chain.desc: Craft the Dark Matter Pickaxe. Check its controls and charge settings in a safe area before using its special abilities near your base.

chain.title: Expand the Collector Branch
chain.desc: Upgrade a collector with Dark Matter. Recheck the receiving machine and transport layout so the extra production has somewhere useful to go.

chain.title: Take the Table with You
chain.desc: Combine the Transmutation Table with the required Dark Matter Blocks to craft a portable tablet. It brings your learned transmutation access with you.

chain.title: A Larger Reserve
chain.desc: Work through the Klein Star upgrades to reach Omega. Follow the installed upgrade recipes and inspect the resulting stored EMC instead of assuming a larger capacity means a full battery.

chain.title: A New Material Tier
chain.desc: Use Dark Matter and Aeternalis Fuel to reach Red Matter. This branch provides the materials for the strongest collector and condenser upgrades.

chain.title: Prepare the Final Machine Components
chain.desc: Form Red Matter Blocks for the recipes that use them. Plan your next machines before converting all of your loose matter.

chain.title: Scale Up the Exchange
chain.desc: Upgrade the first condenser with its Dark and Red Matter components. Configure the target and test input and output handling before connecting bulk storage.

chain.title: A Mature Collector Array
chain.desc: Upgrade the second collector tier with Red Matter. Expand the receiving and relay arrangement alongside production so the completed array supports your actual projects.

chain.title: Take the High Route
chain.desc: Craft Swiftwolf's Rending Gale and supply the EMC or fuel it needs. Test its flight controls near safe ground before crossing a dangerous gap.

chain.title: Several Arts in One Ring
chain.desc: Assemble the constituent rings and band required by the Arcana Ring recipe. Learn its modes and their costs before using it around builds you want to preserve.

chain.title: An Alchemical Workshop
chain.desc: Bring the collector branch, upgraded condenser and portable transmutation together. Produce a useful material through your setup and carry a charged reserve, then confirm the finished workshop.

notes: Original operational guidance verified against local item models, recipes and English tooltips. No pack-authored prose copied.
content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches and usable build milestones

coverage.scope: Authored opening-to-advanced milestones with independent side branches.
limits: EMC values, allowed items and recipe overrides depend on the pack. Working setups and charged reserves use manual confirmation.
The optional Tome of Knowledge is not a required finale because its crafting recipe can be disabled. Equipment side branches do not gate the EMC workshop.
coverage.verification: Local cached JAR data and primary project source. Not a new survival playthrough.
